themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Multiple far-right leaders across Europe and the Americas are confronting legal troubles, electoral setbacks, and internal party conflicts. This theme highlights the convergence of legal battles and political scrutiny affecting figures like Marine Le Pen, Nigel Farage, and Javier Milei, among others.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's conviction for misuse of EU funds and her ongoing appeal dominate political discourse, overshadowing her 2027 presidential campaign.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage resigns as MP amid a police investigation into undeclared donations, triggering a by-election and intensifying scrutiny of his financial dealings.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox faces internal and external challenges, including corruption allegations against regional leaders and tensions with coalition partners in Andalusia.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government grapples with internal disputes, legal pressures, and strained relations with the Church over social policies.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD politicians face legal troubles, including assault allegations and investigations into ties with extremist groups, while the party's electoral prospects fluctuate.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS confronts declining poll numbers, internal divisions, and legal challenges, including allegations of corruption and misuse of public funds.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, often framing them as 'national priority' measures. This theme captures parallel legislative efforts and rhetorical strategies in countries like Spain, Italy, and Hungary.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox pushes for 'national priority' policies in housing, welfare, and migration, including stricter residency requirements and exclusion of irregular migrants from social benefits.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: The Italian government, led by Giorgia Meloni, advances stricter migration policies, including proposals to extend 'ZES' economic zones to border areas to curb immigration.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's government introduces constitutional amendments and policies aimed at tightening migration controls, including stricter residency and citizenship requirements.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP advocates for stricter immigration policies, including a 10-year relocation ban for refugees and opposition to 'Islamization' in Norway.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's campaign emphasizes stricter immigration controls, including opposition to 'Islamization' and prioritization of French nationals in social benefits.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates ahead of NATO summit
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with public exchanges and policy disagreements dominating coverage. This theme highlights the transnational impact of their feud on NATO alliances and broader geopolitical dynamics.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump publicly criticizes Meloni over NATO spending and Iran policy, escalating tensions and straining U.S.-Italy relations.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni responds to Trump's criticism by reaffirming Italy's NATO commitments while defending her government's stance on defense spending and migration.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage and Reform UK amplify Trump's criticisms of European leaders, including Meloni, framing them as weak on immigration and defense.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox aligns with Trump's rhetoric, criticizing Meloni's handling of U.S.-Italy relations and advocating for stronger ties with the Trump administration.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party monitors the Trump-Meloni feud, positioning itself as a potential ally for Trump in Europe.

themes.title: Milei’s ‘shutdown’ policy sparks global right-wing emulation
themes.blurb: Javier Milei's 'shutdown' policy, inspired by U.S. fiscal strategies, is gaining traction among right-wing and libertarian movements worldwide. This theme explores how Milei's economic reforms are being discussed, debated, and emulated by conservative leaders in Europe and the Americas.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government advances a 'shutdown' policy, threatening to halt non-essential state operations to force budget agreements and fiscal reforms.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration officials and allies praise Milei's shutdown policy, framing it as a model for U.S. fiscal conservatism.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leaders express interest in adopting Milei's shutdown policy as part of their broader deregulation and fiscal austerity agenda.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing parties debate the feasibility of adopting Milei-style fiscal policies, particularly in the context of EU budget constraints.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party explores the potential of Milei's shutdown policy as a tool for fiscal reform in France, despite legal and political challenges.

themes.title: Public media crackdowns fuel far-right backlash
themes.blurb: Governments in Hungary, Poland, and Germany are facing backlash from far-right parties over perceived crackdowns on public media. This theme highlights how far-right groups are framing these actions as attacks on free speech and national sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz protests the suspension of pro-Orbán public media outlets, framing it as an attack on free speech and Hungarian sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS accuses the current government of politicizing public media, using it as a tool to suppress conservative voices and manipulate public opinion.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox criticizes Spain's public media for alleged bias against conservative and far-right viewpoints, calling for reforms to ensure balanced coverage.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD accuses German public broadcasters of bias and calls for reforms to ensure fair representation of far-right perspectives.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party criticizes French public media for perceived left-wing bias, advocating for reforms to ensure balanced political representation.
